mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, conditions are mainly clear at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 55 degrees.
The city is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project. Contractors are finishing concrete work and preparing the road for asphalt installation through the fall season.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly report, we look at an incident from October 25, when officers located a driver passed out at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue and made an arrest for an O W I.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Flavor of the Day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
